verdict.rationale: The GST portal publishes first-party help modules covering the gates before filing: registration Part A and Part B with a step-by-step manual, temporary User ID generation, DSC or EVC verification, and first-time login with credential retrieval. These are readable before a user starts. The pack holds only titles and snippets, though, so there is no evidence of a single consolidated statement of every account, credential and identity-proofing prerequisite between a founder and filing. missing for 10: an explicit upfront prerequisites checklist (e.g. PAN/Aadhaar/OTP/DSC requirements stated before onboarding), detail beyond help-page titles, independent or hands-on confirmation that no gates surface mid-flow.
